verdict.rationale: Maritime documents an always-on micro-VM with persistent storage for agents (claude-code docs) and a flat Always-on add-on for agents that must run around the clock. It also offers persistent Linux desktops and flat billing that does not change with how long agents run, so multi-hour or multi-day sessions are supported in principle. Missing for 10: no documented maximum session duration or timeout guarantees, no clarity on whether default idle sleep interrupts in-flight long tasks, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-day runs.
